title: Ethiopian Avocado Juice
community: Addis Ababa juice bars — the signature Ethiopian juice
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Avocado Juice — ripe avocado blended with milk, a little honey, and cardamom into a thick, velvety green drink. One of the most distinctive features of Ethiopia's juice bar culture — blended avocado as a drink is unusual globally but beloved in Ethiopia.
longDesc: Ethiopian avocado juice is one of the things that most surprises international visitors to Addis Ababa's juice bars — the ripe avocado blended with cold milk and honey into a thick, smooth, rich green drink that is unlike anything else. Ethiopia's highlands grow some of Africa's finest avocados.
steps: Add avocado flesh, milk, honey, and cardamom to blender.
Blend until completely smooth and velvety.
chefTips: The avocado must be perfectly ripe — unripe avocado produces a bitter, starchy drink.
Serve immediately — avocado oxidises and turns brown quickly.
Ethiopian avocados are larger and richer than imported varieties — the flavour difference is significant.
Often layered over mango juice in Addis Ababa juice bars — the green over orange is visually stunning.
cookingScience: Avocado's flesh is primarily monounsaturated fat (oleic acid) — when blended with cold milk, the fat creates a stable emulsion with the milk proteins, producing the characteristically velvety, thick texture. The fat also carries the avocado's subtle aromatic compounds, distributing them through every sip.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian highland avocados grown in the Kihamba-style multi-crop system.
healthBenefits: Very high in healthy monounsaturated fats.
The fat in avocado makes it one of the most satiating juice drinks available.
culturalNote: Ethiopian avocado juice is the drink that makes international visitors to Addis Ababa's juice bars stop in their tracks — the idea of blended avocado as a drink is unusual elsewhere, but in Ethiopia it is completely natural and completely delicious. The thick, velvety green juice layered over bright orange mango juice in a tall glass is one of the most distinctive images of Addis Ababa's modern food culture.
